sharp_time_and_generation.free_covariance: for omega_k=sqrt(m0^2+k^2), the sharp-time mode covariance is coth(beta0 omega_k/2)/(2 omega_k)
sharp_time_and_generation.construction: temporal mollifiers eta_epsilon approaching delta_t make Phi(eta_epsilon tensor f) Cauchy in every finite Gaussian Lq; Holder with dnu/dmu in every finite Lp gives a sharp-time Phi_t(f) in L2(nu)
sharp_time_and_generation.continuity: the same covariance difference estimate gives L2(nu)-continuity in t for every smooth spatial f
sharp_time_and_generation.generation: Riemann sums of integral Phi_t(f_t) dt approximate Phi(F) for smooth F, so time translates of the sharp-time algebra generate the full field sigma algebra and the OS cyclic subspace
sharp_time_and_generation.boundary_germ_equivalent: the same construction may be stated with the boundary-germ algebra, avoiding a pathwise trace of a two-dimensional distribution

domain_Markov.free_input: because C^(-1)=m0^2-Delta is local, the massive torus Gaussian field is conditionally independent across a slab D given the germ sigma algebra at the two boundary slices
domain_Markov.interaction_additivity: for a Lipschitz time slab, R=R_D+R_(D^c); Wick chaoses lie in H^(-epsilon) for every epsilon>0 and slab indicators lie in H^s for s<1/2, so the two restrictions are well typed
domain_Markov.Bayes_result: for bounded inside F and outside G, E_nu[FG|G_boundary]=E_nu[F|G_boundary] E_nu[G|G_boundary]
domain_Markov.scope: this is a two-sided germ-domain Markov theorem on the closed beta circle; it is not by itself an ordinary one-sided homogeneous Markov-chain statement after forgetting the closing boundary

common_reference_free_energy.finite_regulator: R_M is whole-Wick centered, E_muM R_M=0, and its fourth Wiener-chaos component is nonzero because g>0; strict Jensen gives Z_M=E exp(R_M)>1
common_reference_free_energy.finite_regulator_sign: Delta F_M^W=-(1/beta0)log Z_M<0 and Delta f_M^W=-(1/(beta0 L))log Z_M<0
common_reference_free_energy.continuum: EXP-000772 gives R_M->R in L2 and exp(R_M)->exp(R) in L1; the constant spacetime/species zero-mode projection of the fourth chaos has coefficient -(g+3lambda)/(4 beta0 L), so R is nonconstant, Z>1 and the strict sign survives on the fixed finite torus
common_reference_free_energy.scalar_gauge_invariant_form: Delta F_ref=-(1/beta0)D(mu||nu)=-(1/beta0)[log Z-E_mu R]<0; this is invariant under R->R-C and equals Delta F^W in the whole-Wick centered representative

common_reference_free_energy.physical_boundary: mu contains inserted m0,beta0,L and has not been derived or selected as the physical no-condensate or empty-space state; the theorem is below a named mathematical reference, not below physical empty space

prior_art_boundary: Periodic OS/KMS reconstruction, massive Gaussian domain Markov, Gibbs variational inequalities and scalar P(phi)2 thermal constructions are established prior art. No global novelty follows from applying and verifying those structures for the already constructed Q3 measure. The separate bounded audit still located no source proving the complete TECT C0/N1-N5/CL8/Q3/Pre-A physical chain.
no_overclaim: This theorem closes a fixed-beta0, fixed-L thermal Euclidean/Q3 mathematical theory and a strict free-energy comparison to its explicitly named Gaussian reference. It does not identify that reference with physical empty space, fix absolute vacuum energy, produce one beta-independent Hamiltonian, prove a ground state, positive-energy vacuum, interacting Hadamard or microlocal-spectrum condition, thermodynamic limit, genuine phase transition, the original fixed-raw or three-dimensional Q3 parent, physical light, C0, N1-N5, C6, CP1, Sector A, or Pre-A.
